macros.name: AnsAppearance
macros.doc: Use this command to change the appearance of the Acrobat checkboxes for the answers that appear in the label margin.

macros.name: AnswerKey
macros.doc: The answer key is always computed and saved in the macro \AnswerKey.

macros.name: displayRandomizedQuestions
macros.doc: The questions are inserted by this command.

macros.name: dpsEmbedIcons
macros.doc: \dpsEmbedIcons embeds icons images into the puzzle document.

macros.name: dpsFinishedEvent
macros.doc: The dps provides the command \dpsFinishedEvent to add JavaScript lines to the action to the end of game event.

macros.name: dpsQuesLayer
macros.doc: Inputs the appropriate content file.

macros.name: dpsResetHook
macros.doc: The dps provides the command \dpsResetHook to add JavaScript lines to the action of \resetDPS.

macros.name: dsthreshold
macros.doc: The command \threshold with its one argument defines the command \dsthreshold which expands to the argument, n, of \threshold.

macros.name: fmtOCGQues
macros.doc: Use this command to format the question layer.

macros.name: htOfA
macros.doc: Sets the height of the checkbox for the answer.

macros.name: htOfQ
macros.doc: Sets the height of the checkbox for the question.

macros.name: inputRandomSeed
macros.doc: With \inputRandomSeed, you input a seed value earlier saved with the option savedata.

macros.name: insertPuzzle
macros.doc: The puzzle, which consists of the first of the paired arguments declared in the \DeclarePuzzle command, is laid out in a tabular format.

macros.name: insertQuesLayer
macros.doc: \insertQuesLayer sets the layer and inputs the formatted content.

macros.name: ltrFmtA
macros.doc: Formats the letters in the list of answers when the option showletters is active.

macros.name: placeOtherIcon
macros.doc: Places an image other than a question.

macros.name: placeOtherLayer
macros.doc: Use \placeOtherLayer to place other non-question content in a layer.

macros.name: placeQuesLayer
macros.doc: For the command \placeQuesLayer places the question layer, symbolically represented by \insertQuesLayer{#1}.

macros.name: PuzzleAppearance
macros.doc: Use this command to change the appearance of the Acrobat text field that comprise the interactive puzzle.

macros.name: QuesAppearance
macros.doc: Use this command to change the appearance of the Acrobat checkboxes for the questions that appear in the label margin.

macros.name: randomizePicMappings
macros.doc: The command \randomizePicMappings, when expanded in the preamble, will randomize the order the tiles appear in the slideshow; the default is no randomization.

macros.name: rowsep
macros.doc: By setting \rowsep, you can adjust the vertical space between tabular rows.

macros.name: sideshowPackaged
macros.doc: The side show pictures are packaged into a single PDF, the order of the pages are as expected.

macros.name: useLastSeed
macros.doc: \useLastSeed initializes the random number generator with the last random number generated in the previous compile.

macros.name: widestFmtdALtr
macros.doc: Sets the width of the checkbox for the answers.

macros.name: widestFmtdQNum
macros.doc: Sets the width of the checkbox for the questions.

envs.name: Composing
envs.doc: You compose the questions and answers within the Composing environment.

envs.name: cQ
envs.doc: Questions are posed within the cQ environment and answers are written within the cA environment.
